facts.fact: Kenya's Communications Authority says its Universal Service Fund mobile infrastructure phases 1-4 targeted 369 sub-locations and 155 are connected to date, within a KES 17.674 billion, 11-project portfolio with an estimated 1.6 million beneficiaries.
facts.system: Universal Service Fund mobile infrastructure phases 1-4

KEN.note: No national digital strategy is named.

facts.fact: The USF portfolio listed by the Communications Authority includes an Education Cloud and Assistive Tech project providing content and devices for learners with print disabilities.

KEN.note: A USF levy and portfolio total are given, but no budget year, budget line or published spending account from 2024.
No online consultation or channel is stated.
KICTANet is described as a multi-stakeholder platform; no research publication is stated.
Consultation is stated as a USF principle and 'limited' in evidence; no named digital law or policy consultation.
